title: Television Remote Control Concept and Design Meeting
summary: The team met to review previous specifications and finalize the design concept for a new television remote control. They listened to three presentations covering market research on aesthetics, user preferences, and technical components. Based on this information, they decided on a curved "snowman" shape, textured yellow plastic casing, rubber buttons flush with the case, and a flat jog dial for navigation. They also agreed to incorporate kinetic hybrid power, a glowing tinted yellow case, and the company slogan while omitting expensive features like an LCD screen or speech talk-back.
topics: Recap of prior remote control specifications
Market research on aesthetics and style trends
Structural and interface suggestions for remotes
Technical analysis of components, materials, and power
Collaborative design session on remote control features
decisions: Adopt a curved snowman shape with a folding mechanism to hide advanced buttons.
Use a yellow and white corporate color scheme with a tinted, slightly transparent yellow case that glows from within.
Use textured plastic and rubber materials, featuring flush, easy-to-press buttons.
Omit the LCD display and voice talk-back function to minimize cost and complexity.
Incorporate a flat jog dial placed down the middle for channel and volume navigation.
Implement a kinetic hybrid power system using a standard battery as a backup.
Print the company slogan on the side of the casing.
